Enhances your <stasis/>Stasis Grenade abilities:

• <stasis/> Coldsnap Grenades duplicate upon freezing an enemy, turning into two and then four additional seekers on hit. For each enemy hit, spawn a Small, Medium, and then Large <stasis/>Stasis Crystal on the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stage of Seeker duplication
• <stasis/>Duskfield Grenades gain 50% increased radius and spawn a Small <stasis/>Stasis Crystal on impact
• <stasis/>Glacial Grenades now form in a heptagon pattern (7-sided circle) with two additional Large <stasis/>Stasis Crystals added to the formation
• <stasis/>Shatter Grenades create ? additional shrapnel upon detonating. Hitting <stasis/>Frozen targets with the Shatter Grenade refunds 20?% Grenade Ability Energy.
